nights.title: Nia Archives
nights.name: Nia Archives
nights.extract: Dehaney Nia Lishahn Hunt, known professionally as Nia Archives, is an English record producer, DJ, singer and songwriter. Born in Bradford in West Yorkshire, she moved to Leeds aged seven, out of the family home aged sixteen, and then to Greater Manchester, during which time she was inspired by jungle documentaries and the women within them.

en.kicker: english record producer, dj and songwriter
en.who: Dehaney Nia Lishahn Hunt, known professionally as Nia Archives, is an English record producer, DJ, singer and songwriter. Born in Bradford, she moved to Leeds aged seven and later to Greater Manchester, where she was inspired by jungle documentaries and the women within them.
facts: Born in Bradford in West Yorkshire, she moved to Leeds aged seven.

facts: Sie wurde in Bradford in West Yorkshire geboren und zog mit sieben Jahren nach Leeds.
Sie ließ sich von Jungle-Dokumentationen und den Frauen darin inspirieren.

facts: West Yorkshire'daki Bradford'da doğdu ve yedi yaşında Leeds'e taşındı.

nights.title: Snakehips
nights.name: Snakehips
nights.extract: Snakehips are a British electronic music duo. The line-up consists of Oliver Lee and James Carter. Snakehips made their name with Hype Machine doing remixes for Banks, The Weeknd, Bondax and Wild Belle. They are best known for their 2015 single, "All My Friends" featuring Tinashe and Chance the Rapper.
